headline: Vivo’s X Fold 6 accidentally feels like a throwback
summary: Vivo's X Fold 6 launched in China, now set for global release. Its size and aspect ratio feel unexpectedly old-fashioned compared to newer foldables. The X Fold 6 maintains the dimensions of previous Vivo foldables.

headline: Elon Musk’s Grokipedia has a ‘newly refreshed’ design
summary: SpaceXAI's Grokipedia, an AI competitor to Wikipedia, received a v0.3 update. The update includes a new logo and refreshed homepage and live edits page. SpaceXAI head of design Benji Taylor describes it as 'newly refreshed.'

headline: The new and huger Paramount has a new co-CEO
summary: Paramount appointed Ynon Kreiz as co-CEO ahead of its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. Kreiz, formerly Mattel's CEO, will join David Ellison in leadership. Ellison will focus on strategy and creative vision for the company.

headline: Neon sticks it to A24 by announcing a Creative Commons SCP Foundation movie
summary: A24 angered the SCP community by announcing a film without contacting the SCP Wiki or committing to a Creative Commons license. Neon capitalized on the situation by announcing its own SCP Foundation movie. Neon's film will be released under the required Creative Commons license.

headline: East of Eden Review
summary: Netflix's "East of Eden" is a new TV series starring Florence Pugh, Christopher Abbott, and Mike Faist. The show is described as beautifully shot and dramatically riveting. It is highly recommended as binge-worthy television.

headline: LEGO PlayStation Is Now Available for LEGO Insiders
summary: The new LEGO PlayStation set is now available for LEGO Insiders. Insiders also receive a free Astro Bot Set with their purchase. Becoming a LEGO Insider is free and offers early access and exclusive deals.

headline: "Extraction is Still a Major Part of Marathon" – Marathon Game Director Reassures Fans Main Game Mode Isn't Going Anywhere
summary: Marathon developers previously outlined a roadmap adding PvE and deathmatch modes. Fans were concerned about the fate of the existing extraction mode. Game Director Del Chafe reassured players that extraction mode will not be removed.

headline: The Flexispot Lotus Swivel Rocker and Recliner Is on Clearance for $250 Plus Free Shipping
summary: The Flexispot Lotus Swivel Rocker and Recliner is currently on clearance. It is available for $250 with free shipping. This chair is promoted for comfortable lounging while gaming.

headline: We fear for our lives after being told our abusive exes will be freed from jail early
summary: Three domestic abuse victims shared their stories with the BBC. They expressed fear and disappointment over an early prisoner release scheme. The scheme allows their abusive ex-partners to be freed from jail ahead of schedule.

headline: US death row inmate survives execution attempt after two lethal injections
summary: Death row inmate Christa Pike survived an execution attempt. She was administered two lethal injections of pentobarbital. Her lawyer states she is now receiving "life-saving measures" in hospital.

headline: Watch: The many questions raised by the failed execution of Christa Pike
summary: The execution of convicted murderer Christa Pike failed after two injections. Her legal team filed an emergency motion to halt the procedure during the attempt. The incident has raised numerous questions about the execution process.

headline: Too early to say what motive for Dubai-Tel Aviv flight attack was, Israeli PM says
summary: An incident occurred on an Israel-bound flight from Dubai where a pilot stabbed another. The pilot is currently under investigation in Saudi Arabia. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated it's too early to determine a motive.
